title: FX6 6.02: the LCD shows the open-gate live view at 3:2, pillarboxed on the 16:9 panel (panel type 1 -> panel code 5, whose fit for a 16:9 picture is pillarbox; 16:9 picture ratio 9/16 -> 2/3), and the built-in De-Squeeze Display ratios set for a 3:2 picture (1.3x 1.95:1, 2.0x the whole frame at 3:1, centre crop off)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin 6.02 (ILME-FX6), its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the words are in the file, the change is made in RAM only
ported_from: lcd32dsq_fx3_v1 (FX3 7.02; its open-gate screen step works on that camera, 2026-11-24): the same 2/3 ratio and de-squeeze ratios; the FX6's 16:9 panel needs the pillarbox fit mode (panel word, new); no frame tables (the FX6 has none)

summary.picture: 16:9 live view (aspect code 2) holding the whole 3:2 sensor area
summary.panel: rear panel-type byte RAM 0x1703944 (type 1 = 16:9 expected; 2 = 4:3, 3 = 3:2 also handled)

while_applied: every 16:9 picture on the LCD is shown at 3:2, pillarboxed (black bars left and right); a 17:9 (DCI) picture fills the LCD (6% taller than true) instead of its letterbox; the de-squeeze ratios are those of a 3:2 picture on every output that de-squeezes (the calculator is shared, HDMI's de-squeeze too), and 2.0x shows any picture at 3:1. HDMI and the 0x40/0x80 outputs keep their own panel codes: on a 16:9 output nothing changes; on a 4096-wide output (code 5) a 16:9 picture is pillarboxed at 3:2 instead of 16:9
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on an FX6

the FX6's rear panel-type byte 0x1703944 (expected 1 = 16:9 from Sony's 2.76M-dot 16:9 LCD; the dump reads it); the display timing table (0xecf1f2) is the FX3's byte for byte, so it does not name the panel
which code the FX6 menu's 2.0x sends (1.3x = 1 and 2.0x = 4 inferred; the design makes code 2 with a 16:9 picture 3:1 too)
whether the FX6 draws focus frames on the plane the second layout (0x60af6e) lays out, and that plane's picture code
which output device id the FX6 LCD uses (1 assumed, as on the FX3; the dump's panel pages show both types)
